ideas.pitch: Low-latency AR navigation for Edinburgh's historic Old Town that routes wheelchair users and delivery carts around cobblestones, steep inclines, and construction zones.
ideas.title: EdinburghCobblestoneNav
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the real-time AR and low-latency execution strategy from BaseScanning, solving a hyper-local, highly relatable problem for anyone trying to navigate Edinburgh's challenging geography.

ideas.pitch: Computer vision tool for Edinburgh tenement housing surveyors to instantly detect and classify dry rot, damp patterns, and sandstone weathering from smartphone videos.
ideas.title: HearthCheck
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to local judges by targeting a ubiquitous problem in historic Scottish stone buildings, combining a working computer vision demo with high local economic relevance.

ideas.pitch: Real-time energy forecasting dashboard predicting local Scottish wind farm curtailment and grid carbon intensity using Poisson regression models and live Met Office weather feeds.
ideas.title: ClydeGridCarbon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the rigorous statistical forecasting methodology and backtesting seen in AI-incident-forecasting, which appeals to technical judges looking for genuine data science rather than wrapper apps.

ideas.pitch: Personalized nutrition scanner tailored to traditional Scottish ingredients and local supermarket inventory, generating culturally resonant meal plans with calibrated micronutrient tracking.
ideas.title: HaggisHealthNut
ideas.why_it_could_win: Takes the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant and injects localized regional relevance, making the demo instantly charming and memorable for local judges.

ideas.pitch: Decentralized performer-to-venue matching and crowd-flow predictor for Edinburgh Festival Fringe organizers to optimize temporary stage allocations and reduce bottleneck congestion.
ideas.title: FringeVenueSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into Edinburgh's cultural identity while presenting a hard graph-intelligence and forecasting challenge that demonstrates impressive technical depth within a 30-hour window.
